title: evaluate() crashes on negative numbers (repro steps from my branch)
body:
Same crash as before. Here is what I run locally:

```bash
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
python -m pytest tests/test_evaluate.py -x
```

Output:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/test_evaluate.py", line 13, in test_negative_operand
    assert evaluate("2 + -3") == -1
  File "src/tinycalc/evaluate.py", line 23, in evaluate
    value = int(tokens[i + 1])
ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: '-'
```

Expected: `evaluate("2 + -3")` returns `-1`.

comments.body: Note that requirements-dev.txt only exists on my working branch, it was never merged to main.
